summary: # Marvelous Designer Tips Class: Master the Shape Line Tool in 30 Seconds ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will explore how to transform a t-shirt into a dress using the Shape Line tools in Marvelous Designer. You won't need to touch the 2D pattern window at all. ## Using the Style Line Tools You can achieve this transformation by utilizing the style line tools available in Marvelous Designer. Start with a default shirt as your base. ### Edit Style Line Tool First, use the **Edit Style Line Tool** to adjust existing seams or hems into any desired shape. This tool allows for precise modifications to the structure of your garment. ### Scale Style Line Tool Next, employ the **Scale Style Line Tool**. This tool is perfect for widening the bottom of the shirt. By adjusting the scale, you can create a more flowing silhouette. ### Move Style Line Tool To modify the length of a seam, use the **Move Style Line Tool**. I suggest doing this adjustment twice to achieve a longer dress. This tool gives you the flexibility to control the overall length effectively. ### Draw Style Line Tool Now, let’s create a waist seam using the **Draw Style Line Tool**. This tool is essential for adding new seams where you want them. ### Final Adjustments with Scale Style Line Tool Finally, go back to the **Scale Style Line Tool** to narrow the waist. This step is crucial for achieving a fitted look that complements the design of your new dress. ## Conclusion By following these steps and utilizing the various style line tools, you can easily convert a t-shirt into a stylish dress in Marvelous Designer. Happy designing!
